test_git_repo_root: test the _git_repo_root function that detects the root of a git repository from a given directory
test_worktree_creation: test the _setup_worktree function that creates an isolated git worktree with a unique hermes branch
test_worktree_cleanup: test the _cleanup_worktree function that removes worktrees without unpushed commits and preserves those with unpushed work
test_stale_worktree_pruning: test the _prune_stale_worktrees garbage collection that removes old clean worktrees and force-prunes worktrees older than 72 hours
test_orphaned_branch_pruning: test the _prune_orphaned_branches function that deletes orphaned hermes/hermes-* and pr-* branches with no active worktree
